title: Measuring Differences between Conditional Distributions using Kernel Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2605.02260v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Comparing conditional distributions is a fundamental challenge in statistics and machine learning, with applications across a wide range of domains. While proposed methods for measuring discrepancies using kernel embeddings of distributions in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) provide powerful non-parametric techniques, the existing literature remains fragmented and lacks a unified theoretical treatment. This paper addresses this gap by establishing a coherent framework for studying kernel-based methods to measure divergence between conditional distributions through what we refer to as conditional maximum mean discrepancy (CMMD). The CMMD consists of a family of metrics which we call levels, with three special cases each using a different type of RKHS embedding: CMMD$_0$ (conditional mean operators), CMMD$_1$ (conditional mean embeddings), and CMMD$_2$ (joint mean embeddings). translated_title: 使用核嵌入度量条件分布之间的差异
translated_abstract: 比较条件分布是统计学和机器学习中的一项基本挑战，在众多领域都有广泛应用。尽管基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中分布核嵌入来度量差异的方法提供了强大的非参数技术，但现有文献仍然较为分散，缺乏统一的理论处理。本文通过建立一个连贯的框架来弥补这一空白，用于研究基于核的方法，通过我们称之为条件最大均值差异（CMMD）来度量条件分布之间的散度。CMMD 由一系列我们称之为“层级”的度量组成，其中包含三个特例，每个特例使用不同类型的 RKHS 嵌入：CMMD$_0$（条件均值算子）、CMMD$_1$（条件均值嵌入）和 CMMD$_2$（联合均值嵌入）。我们还进一步引入了一个一般层级……
tldr: 本文提出了条件最大均值差异（CMMD）这一统一理论框架，通过不同层级的核嵌入度量方法，系统性地解决了条件分布之间差异度量缺乏统一理论处理的问题。
